yara_rules.author: daniyyell
yara_rules.description: Detects suspicious PowerShell activity related to malware execution

comments.comment: PowerShell Roblox credential stealer, 28.8 KB, served live at https://kkam.download/run. Purpose: steal the .ROBLOSECURITY cookie — this cookie is a full Roblox session token, so theft equals full account takeover (Robux, limiteds, groups). Chromium family (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera/GX, Vivaldi): if the browser runs, a C# ReadProcessMemory scanner walks the --type=network-service process (up to 512 MB in 4 MB chunks) for the needle string "_|WARNING:-DO-NOT-SHARE-THIS" (start of every ROBLOSECURITY cookie); falls back to scanning all browser processes. If the browser is closed, the script starts the real browser binary headless with --remote-debugging-port on a random port, enumerates profiles (Default, Profile N), reads all cookies over the Chrome DevTools Protocol (Network.getAllCookies, WebSocket), then taskkill /F /T the browser tree. Firefox: built-in SQLite b-tree leaf-page parser (varint + serial-type decoding) reads cookies.sqlite directly including -wal frames — no Sqlite3.dll needed. Geolocation of victim via ipapi.co / ipwho.is / ipinfo.io (country code). Exfil: POST https://kkam.download/info, JSON body {cookie, country_code}. The server evaluates the account for the operator: username, id, creation date, ban status, Robux + pending Robux, owned groups with group funds, and played-checks for Loomian Legacy, Murder Mystery 2, Adopt Me (valuable-account triage for resale). Local transcript %TEMP%\roblox_lookup.txt. Distribution: fake Minecraft "Baritone" mod jars; this stealer runs in parallel with an XMRig miner installed by the same chain (xaerosminimap.com/deploy.ps1). Infra: kkam.download and xaerosminimap.com both resolve to 202.170.75.132 (AS219067).
